summary: Completed requested backend + frontend validation for Arabic copy updates, admin user deletion/permission controls, reconciliation access by manage_reconciliations-only user, and setup.exe MZ signature.
action_items: No blocking fixes required for requested scope.
Optional cleanup: remove temporary UI user ui_mr_only_1745696408 and its test reconciliation record if not needed.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical functional defect found in requested scope.
backend/server.py remains monolithic (>1200 lines), increasing regression risk and making permission changes harder to isolate safely.
Least-privilege caution: manage_reconciliations defaults to true in both backend UserPermissions and admin new-user form, which may grant extra access unless explicitly toggled off.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary users via UI/API (ui_mr_only_1745696408, transient delete-test users) and one reconciliation record ITER12 1745696408 for manage_reconciliations-only flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://scanner-ocr-test.preview.emergentagent.com. Login page shows updated organization/title text and removed legacy sentence. /deposits subtitle updated as requested, and phrases 'تقارير منفصلة' and '3 بنوك' not found in page content. Admin panel shows and can toggle 'إدارة التسويات البنكية' for existing users; admin can delete non-admin user. API DELETE /api/admin/users/{user_id} rejects non-admin caller and rejects admin target (403). manage_reconciliations-only user can access reconciliation module and save memo successfully. setup.exe verified MZ via /api/download/setup and /app/dist/BankDepositSystemSetup.exe.
rca of the issue: No product issue reproduced in requested scope. One Playwright stderr message (Dialog.accept already handled) was test-harness related due duplicate dialog accept registration, not an app defect.
